note: The parts a geared humanoid's reference is split into for the layered build (scripts/auto_part_map.py, then scripts/revamp/raider/project_parts.py onward). phrase: the part's words in the joint query (every part in one prompt, so they compete for each box; no two phrases share a word, so a box's label maps back to its part). prompts: the part's own fuller queries, run as well. layer: where two masks overlap the higher layer wins (buckles on belts, straps on plates), except that a non-base part nested in a bigger mask at most one layer above it wins inside it. max_box: the largest box the part may take, as a fraction of the figure's bounding box. zone: where the box centre may sit, 0 at the crown and 1 at the soles of a standing figure (A or T pose; arms have no zone). single: the character has one (a waist belt, a face), so only its best box is kept. mirror: a paired part; one found on a side alone is looked for in its mirrored box and kept when the mask there matches in size and colour (within mirror_delta_e). as: written under another part's name. base: the cloth and skin everything else is worn over; unclaimed character pixels take the nearest one. body: what is left when the equipment is taken off (project_parts.py's prior for faces hidden from the front). max_width: a thin part keeps only the parts of its mask no wider than this fraction of the figure's height. rel_score: a box scoring under this share of an overlapping box of the same part is dropped. bare_skin: cloth pixels within max_delta_e (CIE Lab) of the face's median colour that touch the face or detected skin become face or skin.
